versions.changelog:
Initial release: An all-in-one international standard reference for smart transportation and AI-enabled digital transformation.

- Covers 15 transport modes, 130+ digital scenarios, 25 AI applications, 140+ vendors, and 12 vendor categories.
- Includes strict output specifications, legal/disclaimer sections, and author contact.
- Enforces 10 core operational constraints for safety, vendor neutrality, standards, ROI, security, and audience tailoring.
- Supports any leading AI agent, transforming it into a world-class transportation technology advisor.
- Delivers transparency in data sources and methodology for quantitative benchmarks.
